name: ProLiance Heartland Pipeline (Indiana)
researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration lists this as Heartland Pipeline, built by ProLiance Energy, a new 25 mile, 16 inch, 80 MMcf/d state-regulated line in Indiana, completed December 2006 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 420, August 2026 release). The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission approved a certificate for Heartland Gas Pipeline LLC on October 5, 2005 (Cause 42729), and the Federal Register notice of July 11, 2006 (docket CP06-406) places its facilities in Sullivan, Owen, Clay and Greene Counties. Members were Citizens By-Products Coal Company and a ProLiance subsidiary; ownership shares were not found, so the Owner is the operating company and owner percentages are left blank. Search snippets give 25.2 miles but the page text was not read, so the staged length is the EIA figure. Exact start and end points were not found. It is not the ANR Heartland Project (P7793) and no existing GEM row covers it. It is operating, 25 miles is above the 15.5 mile threshold. Tier medium: EIA is one source for the numbers, the state and federal documents confirm existence, sponsor and counties only. No route research done; RouteType and RouteAccuracy left blank for the routes step. Next step is to read the Indiana commission order for Cause 42729 for endpoints and length.
